cases.expected_behavior: Produces an HTML report containing the experiment design and a summary of observed results. cases.prompt: Run a small questionnaire to compare two prompt styles for robustness.

cases.prompt: Explain how LLMs work at a high level.
cases.expected_behavior: This is an explanation request, not a capability experiment.

cases.prompt: Compare these model instruction-following results: prompt style A passed 3 of 5 cases and style B passed 4 of 5. HTML cannot render in this client; provide the experiment summary in plaintext instead.
